title: Voice message
summary: The timeline row of a voice message or audio file: play and pause, a waveform with progress, the duration, and the sender's transcript under it (ADR 0023). A received voice message without one can be transcribed on the listener's phone (bipe#500). The scam check reads the sender's transcript.

isVoice.description: true for a voice message (has the voice marker), false for an audio file.

waveform.description: From the event; empty draws a flat line.

transcript.description: The caption of a voice message. Missing when the sender sent none.

playback.description: The player state of this row.

transcriptExpanded.description: true after the person tapped show more.

localTranscript.description: The listener's own transcript (bipe#500). none: bipe_voice_transcribe shows. working: bipe_voice_transcribing. ready: the text with bipe_voice_transcript_title and bipe_voice_transcribed_here. unavailable: no on-device recognizer for the language (bipe_voice_transcribe_unavailable). denied: speech recognition not allowed (bipe_voice_transcribe_denied). failed: bipe_voice_transcribe_failed, and the button shows again.

localTranscriptText.description: ready only: the text the phone recognised.

togglePlay.effect: Downloads the audio to the cache when needed, then plays or pauses. Starting one row stops any other.

seek.effect: Drag on the waveform: moves the position.

transcribe.effect: A received voice message (isVoice, not own) without a sender's transcript: downloads the audio to the cache when needed, then transcribes it on the phone only (iOS Speech with requiresOnDeviceRecognition; Android SpeechRecognizer.createOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer). Sets localTranscript.

toggleTranscript.effect: Shows the whole transcript, or collapses it to 3 lines.

notes: ADR 0023: Bipe never captions a voice message in another way, so the caption of a voice message is the transcript.

Listener transcript (bipe#500, option (a) of the issue, which changes ADR 0023 point 1 for received messages): only on a tap of bipe_voice_transcribe, never automatic. Recognition runs on the phone only, with the phone's preferred languages then pt-BR, as on the sender side; the app never falls back to a server, and with no on-device recognizer it shows unavailable. The audio and the text never leave the phone: the text lives in memory for the session, is not stored, not sent and not shown to the sender. It is the listener's own reading, so it carries bipe_voice_transcribed_here and the scam check does not read it.
Transcript block: bipe_voice_transcript_title, then the text in 3 lines. Over 140 characters, bipe_action_show_more and bipe_action_show_less toggle it (same rule as the forks).
The scam check (scam-warning) reads the transcript of incoming voice messages; the card goes under the transcript.
The transcript is the sender's text, not proof of what was said; the row does not claim otherwise.
Playback goes on with the screen locked and stops when another row plays or a call or other audio starts. Speaker by default; the earpiece when the phone is at the ear.
Audio files (no voice marker) show the same player with the file name and no transcript.
bipe_app_voice_play and bipe_app_voice_pause are the button accessibility labels. bipe_app_media_voice is the preview text for replies, the chat list and notifications.
Recording and the sender-side transcript (voice-transcript-send, BipeKit VoiceTranscriber.swift, libraries/bipe voice/BipeVoiceTranscriber.kt) are the composer issue, not this spec.
